voices.name: l00
voices.text: Tired of every text, <#0.2#> and secretly relieved when plans get canceled?
voices.caption: Tired of every text, and secretly relieved when plans get canceled?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: The gatherings you used to love, <#0.2#> now strangely empty?
voices.caption: The gatherings you used to love, now strangely empty?

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Nothing's wrong with you. <#0.3#> Many people pass through this right before their life changes.
voices.caption: Nothing's wrong with you. Many people pass through this right before their life changes.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: When your energy shifts, <#0.2#> you stop resonating with the old people.
voices.caption: When your energy shifts, you stop resonating with the old people.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Korean saju says, <#0.2#> when your fortune turns, people fall away first.
voices.caption: Korean saju says, when your fortune turns, people fall away first.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: So don't hold on to who's leaving. <#0.2#> A new chapter is being set up.
voices.caption: So don't hold on to who's leaving. A new chapter is being set up.
